objective: Separate observed/predicted TJ, latent slow state and smooth-control demand; evaluate slow-state information beyond simple filters.
outputs: TTO-快慢热状态与平稳散热需求-研究报告.md
TTO-快慢热状态与平稳散热需求-研究证据包.zip

implementation_freeze.parameters: copied immutable model JSON; no dynamic optimization
implementation_freeze.run_E: sealed first causal 60 s prefix calibration, fixed for run; never training E
implementation_freeze.A_long: exact 2D propagation with saved causal Ts_initial, score only after 60 s; no TJ feedback
implementation_freeze.causal_state: sealed past-60 state[1]; state[0] anchored observed TJ is not prediction
implementation_freeze.LP: union of actual accepted TJ and successful input event nodes, exact left hold; prefix replay only after E known
implementation_freeze.LP_memory: all past in strict segment, compared with fixed 60 s G2 window; no window search
implementation_freeze.comparison: four branches use identical per-horizon (origin ref,h,label ref) inherited from sealed primary
implementation_freeze.main_context: confirmed_normal; every other v2 context and legacy strict separately retained
implementation_freeze.weights: per-origin unweighted metrics plus support seconds; no pooled-win claims across unequal cohorts
implementation_freeze.model_sensitivity: old_LS / primary / A24, absolute and one fixed first legal reference per run
implementation_freeze.demand_reference: first legal branch state of each strict segment; not equilibrium or ambient
implementation_freeze.demand_sampling: at actual legal accepted-TJ origins, real dt; fast ledger at every raw node plus known validity expiries
implementation_freeze.demand_invalid: null immediately, clear held output; no cross-gap carry; rebuild existing 60 s qualification
implementation_freeze.reversals: cumulative excursion >=0.02 from last extreme (turning-point hysteresis)
implementation_freeze.saturation: raw<0 or raw>1 duration, plus at-boundary duration; also raw amplitude retained
implementation_freeze.tail_return: first crossing target/output <=0.02 or state <=reference+0.2 C; report censor/recross
implementation_freeze.tail_censor: next request, qualification loss, source/reference change or record end; no extrapolated return
implementation_freeze.event_metadata: posthoc annotation and diagnostics only; never state/filter/demand features
implementation_freeze.resource_policy: CPU single BLAS thread; soft 3600 s budget; own child resource counters
implementation_freeze.runtime_actions: local file reads/writes and CPU kernel only; no network or device functions
requested_outputs: fast event ledger and normal demand
